Possessive pronouns my / your / his / he: my/your/his/her/its/our/their express belonging and are followed by nouns; do not confuse them with pronoun or contracted forms.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:Adjectival possessive pronouns must be followed by nouns; nominal ones stand alone。

my + noun = my things|his/her distinguishes gender but the form is the same for subject and object|their = their, theirs = their things|your can be singular or plural|its means 'something's', it's = it is

column4: 考查Adjectival possessive pronouns must be followed by nouns; nominal ones stand alone。此处应为 my。句意:这是我的笔记本。
